snippet.title: Ugoku Sushi Bar - Cozy Sushi Recipes - Gameplay Trailer (Steam)
snippet.description:
Become a sushi chef in a cozy Japanese conveyor belt sushi bar! 🍣 Prepare and plate a variety of Japanese cuisine orders, serve quirky customers, learn new recipes, unlock fresh ingredients, upgrade your kitchen, and build relationships with your regular customers.

Wishlist on Steam to get notified when the free demo is released:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/3938640/Ugoku_Sushi_Bar/
